Add weekly subscription support

- Users can now add weekly subscriptions with `subtrack add "name" price --every week`
- Weekly subscriptions charge every 7 days from their first charge date
- Monthly cost is calculated as price × 52 ÷ 12, rounded to the nearest cent
- Weekly subscriptions appear in renewals like any other subscription
- Fixed renewals sorting to use actual dates instead of short labels
- Changed monthly cost calculation to use rounding instead of flooring for consistency
- Updated export.js to use monthlyCents() function for correct monthly cost calculation

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
